cohort: 71,878 toddler-mother pairs from the Japan Environment and Children's Study
finding: The prevalence of functional constipation in 3-year-old Japanese toddlers was higher in those born by cesarean delivery compared with those born by vaginal delivery, after adjusting for 22 confounders.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher prevalence of functional constipation in 3-year-old Japanese toddlers compared to vaginal delivery.
